security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Supply chain planning that runs entirely offline
bundle.longDescription: A supply chain planning layer for small manufacturers. Forecasts demand, plans material requirements, checks capacity and balances long-haul work across a fleet. Runs entirely on this machine: no account, no network access, no telemetry.
